messages.content: When will be sunset in Beijing today?

function.name: calculate_sunrise
function.description: Calculate the time of sunrise for a specific date and location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which sunrise time needs to be calculated.

date.description: The date for which sunrise time needs to be calculated in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, current date is considered. Default: 1998-12-03

format.description: Format in which the time should be returned. If not provided, default format 'HH:MM' is considered.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have a function available to calculate sunset times. I can help you find the sunrise time for Beijing today if that would be useful.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "When will be sunset in Beijing today?" We need to calculate sunset time. The tool only calculates sunrise. There's no sunset function. We cannot compute sunset directly. We can respond that we don't have a function for sunset. We can ask if they'd like sunrise instead. Or we can explain limitation. According to policy, we should not fabricate. So we should say we can't compute sunset.
